title: Fellowship in Pain Medicine
inst: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
Department: Department of Anaesthesiology, Pain Medicine and Critical Care
Start: July session - join 1-15 July (extension possible to 31 July)
Deadline: July 2025 session: online registration 9-23 April 2025 (closed); fellowships are advertised by session (January/July) - check aiimsexams.ac.in for the current prospectus
Eligibility: MD in Anaesthesiology / Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation / Palliative Medicine (MCI/NMC-recognised or equivalent) with 3 years post-PG Senior Resident experience, or DM Onco-Anaesthesiology / Neuro-Anaesthesiology
International applicants: Yes - foreign nationals may apply against the 'Sponsored' seats: registration slip must be sent through the diplomatic channel, a 'No Objection' from the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (Government of India) is required, and candidates sit the same entrance examination; no seats reserved for foreign nationals except under bilateral agreements
Accreditation: AIIMS institutional fellowship; exit examination (40% internal assessment, 60% practical final exam)
Application method: Online registration on aiimsexams.ac.in; two-stage selection - 60-mark computer-based MCQ test in Delhi/NCR plus 40-mark departmental clinical/practical assessment (50% minimum in each stage)
Funding: Open candidates paid as Senior Resident (3rd year plus 2 increments, 7th CPC); sponsored candidates and foreign nationals receive no emoluments; admission fee Rs 125 (open) / Rs 1,295 (sponsored)
Licence requirement: Selected foreign nationals must be registered with the Medical Council of India / National Medical Commission before joining
Summary: One-year AIIMS fellowship in pain medicine in the Department of Anaesthesiology, Pain Medicine and Critical Care.
